costs.intro: A BMW X4 xDrive20d engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW X4 xDrive20d engine rebuild starts from £2,200 for the 4-cylinder diesel (N47 or B47). The xDrive30d with the 3.0-litre B57 6-cylinder diesel starts from £2,800. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
